title: Session Setup
description: Read how the session's input mode, input role, and stream mode selectors are currently configured, and understand what they control before changing anything.
before_you_start: You can read this guide with the engine stopped. It opens settings pages and highlights controls; changes and tests are explicit user actions.
learning_outcomes: Identify the input mode, input role, and stream mode selectors
Know that a change applies only when you make it yourself and save where offered

steps.title: Choose how input is captured
steps.body: Read Input mode. Text Only disables microphone recognition while keeping typing available. Voice Activation listens for speech, Push-to-Talk records while its hotkey is held, and Always On uses continuous input. Open the list to compare choices; keep the current value for a read-only tour. Microphone modes require configured speech recognition.

steps.title: Understand the submitted role
steps.body: Read Input role. It determines the conversation role used for submitted input; it does not rename a Discord account or change your persona. Keep the ordinary user role unless your workflow needs another role. Selecting a value applies an actual setting, so note the previous value before experimenting.

steps.title: Decide whether replies stream
steps.body: Read Stream mode. On requests streamed replies where the selected language provider supports them. Off requests a complete response. This setting does not switch provider or model. You can compare the choices without starting the engine; a live response is needed to verify streaming behavior.

steps.title: Find the session shortcuts
steps.body: Look below the selectors for preset and workspace actions. Pinning keeps a compact Session setup summary above other Runtime Session pages. Read the displayed Push-to-Talk shortcut before using voice. Your configuration tour is complete when you can identify input mode, role and streaming without leaving this page.
